question: Does the automatic spiral fit (Nieuwlaar's PHerc. 343 recipe run on PHerc0841, 9.366 um), placed with ONE frozen anchor point, read rows over the whole 20 x 11.7 mm known-text window for both blind raters, as the readable control does?
window: PHerc0841 known-text window W; every W picture masked to the shared frame (control mask x coverage of both arms, 0.958)
raters: sebastien (8 pictures, no guard picture: amendment 3, written before any rating)

arms.A1: arm: the automatic spiral-fit winding nearest the anchor point (one anchor; post-snap; w054 of the fit, 5.73 voxels away)
arms.A2: arm: the second-nearest winding (w055, 8.52 voxels; the anchor sits between the two)

control.C: readable control: w00's own render of the window, masked to the shared frame

pictures.guard: Chris only: a W picture he had already called not rows blind, drawn by a frozen rule (exactly one earlier showing)
pictures.calib: calibration: a known-rows ink map of another public fragment's known text (not this window), a picture both raters had rated before
pictures.calib_blank: the calibration map in the wrong layer order (wrong-order blank)

exposure: before this page Chris had seen the control C 6 times byte-identical and Sebastien once (+2 re-framed showings each); both raters know the window

per_rater.VOID: a picture unanswered, calibration not rows, or the answers earlier than the page build
per_rater.INVALID: more than 1 of the blanks (C_blank, A1_blank, A2_blank, calibration blank) called rows
per_rater.VALID / VALID-LENIENT: VALID-LENIENT when the guard is called rows: a lenient rater's rows calls do not count toward a READS outcome; his not-rows calls still count
per_rater.amendment 3 (Sebastien, no guard): VALID only if he calls EVERY empty picture not rows; exactly one empty picture called rows = VALID-LENIENT; more than one = INVALID

outcome_first_match.1 SPIRAL-NO-ROWS: a valid (or valid-lenient) rater calls every shown arm not rows; one rater suffices; labelled '(one rater)' unless both
outcome_first_match.2 SPIRAL-READS: both raters VALID (not lenient) and both call A1 rows
outcome_first_match.3 SPIRAL-READS-WITH-PICK: both VALID, A1 fails for at least one, both call A2 rows (best of two)
outcome_first_match.4 SPLIT: anything else with two valid raters
outcome_first_match.5 INCONCLUSIVE: exactly one valid rater and no NO-ROWS

description_vs_w00: over the shared frame (local errors, decides nothing): A1 median 81.5 um from w00, A2 68.0 um; the arms lie a median 127 um apart, about one fit-winding spacing

stage0.note: arms, separation 127 um (bar 24), seam 0.0, control rebuilt pixel-identical, shared coverage 0.958, blanks gate (A2 0.176 vs 0.195), frame gap 0.07 pt (bar 2.0)
